## Featured Systems

- [TrustRAG](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/TrustRAG): Local-first 8-stage RAG reliability workbench (ONNX BGE-small + BM25 RRF, atomic claim decomposition, NLI verification, SHA-256 audit, bounded LangGraph recovery, MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server, Ollama/llama.cpp/MLX).
- [CareerOS-Pro](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/CareerOS-Pro): Self-hosted job-intelligence platform with deterministic normalization/deduplication, MySQL 8, embedded Qdrant, LangGraph human-review interrupt, Gemini grounding, and 218 pytest tests.
- [ApplyOS](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/ApplyOS): Local-first multi-runtime job application framework (Bun workspace, 14 job/ATS providers, 9-gate deterministic ranker, LaTeX ATS PDF verification, 4 offline eval suites).
- [Agentic DocuChat](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/MCP_Agentic_DocuChat): Local-first PDF RAG with page-level citations, ChromaDB content-hash caching, Composio MCP tools, and 102 unit tests.
- [Resume Crew](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/Resume_Crew): Evidence-only resume-to-JD match reports with MLX-LM/Ollama local inference and 9 exported artifacts per run.
- [MCP Agents Suite](https://github.com/MaithreshVaddi-27/MCP_SkillMap_Agent): Multi-turn CLI agents over Composio MCP and LangGraph memory (SkillMap, SalaryInsights, CourseFinder, Email Inbox Summarizer).
